manifest.description: Personalized AWS guidance built on patterns from 350,000+ startups—architecture, cost, security, and migration, from day-one account setup to production-ready infrastructure. Migrate to AWS from GCP or Heroku—including your entire AI stack: OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDK rewrites to Amazon Bedrock, agentic systems (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen) to AWS-native runtimes, and Temporal workers. Includes AWS Activate credits eligibility and 60+ exclusive startup offers. Built by AWS Startup Solutions Architects, with multi-account, multi-region support.
manifest.name: aws-startup-advisor
